thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD SLO ALERT: streaming-generation p99 latency breached >10s for model-redwood/gptx-int8-calib-v2 in us-west-2. Spike started ~2273019960.
emma (oncall): seeing the alert. p95 also up. any idea if this is related to the recent int8 calibration rollout?
raj (eng-runtime): I'm seeing a correlation with the int8-calib-v2 tag. Telemetry shows a huge increase in KV cache misses and dequant CPU usage. p99 jump from ~800ms -> ~11.2s. p95 from 210ms -> ~2.6s.
maria (eng-sre): paging in case we need infra-level mitigation. Are any dedicated pools overloaded or paging to other regions?
david (prod): CS reports two customers reported streaming stalls and partial responses. Could be impacting SLAs.
li (cs): confirmed: three seats experiencing streaming stalls, sessions hang after ~60 tokens. Customers are asking for ETA.
emma (oncall): ok, immediate plan: 1) throttle or route traffic off int8-calib-v2 2) roll back profile or force fallback to fp16 3) notify customers. Which is lowest-risk fast path?
raj (eng-runtime): fast path: modify routing policy to prefer model-redwood/gptx-int8-calib-v1 (previous stable) in us-west-2. I can flip that routing weight now. Also enable model-level fallback to fp16 for streaming routes.
maria (eng-sre): can we do a temporary rate-limit on best-effort tier to reduce queuing? Might reduce tail.
ops-bot: command received: /route-set --model int8-calib-v2 --weight 0.2 --region us-west-2 --reason "emergency mitigation"
raj (eng-runtime): running the route change now. curl command: ```bash
# switch routing weights
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/routing/change -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gptx-int8-calib-v2","region":"us-west-2","weight":0.0}'
```
ops-bot: routing change submitted, awaiting propagation (~30s).
emma (oncall): rolling update to fallback profile enabled?
raj (eng-runtime): toggled streaming_fallback_to_fp16 = true for service route id svc-341. Config snippet: ```json
{"service":"streaming","fallback":"fp16","timeout_ms":60000}
```
david (prod): notifying impacted customers via CSM. li please share existing workaround (pin to stable model)
li (cs): sending note to customers: "We're aware of streaming stalls and have routed traffic to a stable model; minimal disruption expected. Will update in 30m."
maria (eng-sre): checking infra: no CPU/GPU timeouts, but node-level process shows repeated dequant exceptions in logs around 2273019955. Likely calibration fallback path exercising a slow code path.
emma (oncall): how are SLIs trending after the routing change?
raj (eng-runtime): early indicators: p95 dropping from 2.6s -> 480ms within 45s; p99 trending down but still elevated around 4.3s. KV cache hit rate improving.
emma (oncall): good. keep monitoring. If p99 doesn't go under 2s in 10m we escalate rollback.
ops-bot: dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/streaming/model-redwood/gptx-int8-calib-v2?from=2273019800&to=2273020200
emma (oncall): can we capture a repro trace for the slow path? Need request ids.
raj (eng-runtime): enabling debug sampling for 1% of streaming requests for int8-calib-v2 to collect KV cache metrics and stack traces. Command: `/debug-sample add --model gptx-int8-calib-v2 --rate 0.01`
ops-bot: debug sampling enabled. logs will drop into s3://redwood-ops/incident/2273019999/
maria (eng-sre): also adding a temporary autoscaler bump for us-west-2 pool to 15% extra until end of incident window to reduce queuing.
david (prod): CSMs asking if we should prepare an incident status page. li can you draft a short blurb?
li (cs): drafting: "We observed elevated streaming latencies affecting a subset of customers in us-west-2 after a precision-profile calibration rollout. We've routed traffic to a stable variant and enabled fp16 fallback. We're investigating root cause and will follow up in 1 hour."
emma (oncall): timeline & actions so far: - alert 2273019960 - started routing changes 2273019995 - fallback enabled 2273020020 - p95 improved 2273020065. Add to thread.
raj (eng-runtime): quick note: the calibration artifacts for int8-calib-v2 had an edge-case quant table entry that causes excessive dequant reorders under long-context streaming. Reproducer attached in debug logs.
maria (eng-sre): recommend we mark rollout as paused org-wide until fix merged. Also prepare rollback of calibration artifacts in model registry.
emma (oncall): agree. Raj or eng-runtime: can you pause the model-tag rollout and promote int8-calib-v1 as default?
raj (eng-runtime): pausing rollout via model-registry: ```bash
curl -X POST https://model-registry.internal/v1/rollouts/2273/pause -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
``` - done. Promoting v1 default now.
ops-bot: model-registry: rollout 2273 paused by raj at 2273020300. Default model set to gptx-int8-calib-v1.
emma (oncall): excellent. any customer-facing impact from this promotion?
li (cs): none expected, customers already routed to stable. I'll send update: "Rollout paused and traffic restored to stable variant; monitoring continues."
david (prod): track any regression for lower accuracy when falling back to fp16; product wants brief note if quality changes.
raj (eng-runtime): we'll run a quick smoke eval of 50 golden prompts against v1 and fp16 fallback to ensure no major regressions. reporting in ~15m.
maria (eng-sre): moving incident to active mitigation. tagging followups: ENG-RUNTIME for fix, ENG-SRE for capacity checks, ENG-MODELS for calibration patch.
emma (oncall): assigning oncall followup: raj takes lead for fix, maria does post-incident capacity report, li handles comms. If p99 not under 2s by 2273020600 escalate to oncall manager.
ops-bot: created incident ticket INC-2026-411 in tracker with links to grafana, logs, model-registry and routing changes.
emma (oncall): final note before we monitor: please add any discovered root cause pointers here.
raj (eng-runtime): preliminary root cause: malformed quantization table entry triggered a slow dequant path when KV cache misses coincide with long-context streaming. Fix will validate quant table key ordering and add guard for dequant reorder.
maria (eng-sre): postmortem checklist: capture request traces, timeline, exact config diffs, customer impact matrix, and a rollback playbook entry.
li (cs): customers notified, next update in 30m.
emma (oncall): closing the paging loop for now; continue monitoring. If anything new, re-ping #incidents. :white_check_mark:
